text: PAX Assistance was founded by Alexia Keglevich, who is its CEO, per the company's own About page; the travel-assistance company is Argentine in origin and operates in Chile as PAX Assistance Chile SpA. Shareholdings beyond the founder are not public.
short: PAX Assistance was founded by Alexia Keglevich, its CEO.

source.name: PAX Assistance: Quiénes somos (paxassistance.com/cl)
source.quote: PAX nace de la visión de Alexia Keglevich, fundadora, CEO y referente internacional en asistencia al viajero
source.note: English: PAX is born of the vision of Alexia Keglevich, founder, CEO. No further shareholding is disclosed on the site; the page is undated, checked 2026-10-04.
